issue_context.title: HomeKit integration via YAML not working
issue_context.body:
### The problem

I am trying to configure the HomeKit integration via YAML for greater control over the entities I pass through. However, I cannot get the integration to work with the YAML. I have followed the troubleshooting steps and am only trying a very basic config anyway.

If I use the Integrations UI, I can get the HomeKit integration to run and pass devices into my HomeKit, but I only wish to pass one device (input_boolean) through. I have tried to get the YAML to work with and without the UI Integration present.

### What is version of Home Assistant Core has the issue?

core-2021.3.4

### What was the last working version of Home Assistant Core?

_No response_

### What type of installation are you running?

Home Assistant OS

### Integration causing the issue

HomeKit

### Link to integration documentation on our website

https://www.home-assistant.io/integrations/homekit

### Example YAML snippet

```yaml
# Put your YAML below this line
homeassistant:
  customize: !include customize.yaml

# Configure a default setup of Home Assistant (frontend, api, etc)
default_config:
mobile_app:
discovery:

# Text to speech
tts:
  - platform: google_translate

group: !include groups.yaml
automation: !include automations.yaml
script: !include scripts.yaml
scene: !include scenes.yaml

homekit:
  filter:
    include_entities:
      - input_boolean.test1
```


### Anything in the logs that might be useful for us?

```txt
# Put your logs below this line
2021-03-20 15:53:28 ERROR (MainThread) [homeassistant] Error doing job: Task exception was never retrieved
Traceback (most recent call last):
  File "/usr/src/homeassistant/homeassistant/data_entry_flow.py", line 133, in async_init
    result = await self._async_handle_step(
  File "/usr/src/homeassistant/homeassistant/data_entry_flow.py", line 216, in _async_handle_step
    result: Dict = await getattr(flow, method)(user_input)
  File "/usr/src/homeassistant/homeassistant/components/homekit/config_flow.py", line 213, in async_step_import
    if not self._async_is_unique_name_port(user_input):
  File "/usr/src/homeassistant/homeassistant/components/homekit/config_flow.py", line 251, in _async_is_unique_name_port
    if entry.data[CONF_NAME] == name or entry.data[CONF_PORT] == port:
KeyError: 'name'
```


I have even tried configuring HomeKit with no Filter via YAML and this does not work either.
I've included the entire beginning of the configuration.yaml file in case there's some error there but all below integrations work fine.

I have also restored HASS to a snapshot taken before any HomeKit fettling began and copied the attached HomeKit Config into the YAML (without adding the UI Integration) and still it gives this error and does not load.

I have reached out on Discord already, but I apologise if this is my own error.

Thanks for your time.
comments:
It looks like you are missing the HomeKit port in your configuration (and this is eluded to in your logs as well):

```YAML
homekit:
  - name: Home Assistant
    port: 56328
    filter:
      include_entities:
        - input_boolean.test1
```

Each HomeKit server requires its own port, so change this accordingly if you want to run multiple instances (I personally run 7 of them, each with a different name and port).

Thanks for your reply. I'm only trying to run one (HASS) HomeKit server.
I restored to my snapshot, added the input_boolean.test1 to Helpers.
Copied what you gave above into my configuration.yaml and restarted Core.

I received this error:

> 2021-03-20 16:31:01 ERROR (MainThread) [homeassistant] Error doing job: Task exception was never retrieved
> Traceback (most recent call last):
>   File "/usr/src/homeassistant/homeassistant/data_entry_flow.py", line 133, in async_init
>     result = await self._async_handle_step(
>   File "/usr/src/homeassistant/homeassistant/data_entry_flow.py", line 216, in _async_handle_step
>     result: Dict = await getattr(flow, method)(user_input)
>   File "/usr/src/homeassistant/homeassistant/components/homekit/config_flow.py", line 213, in async_step_import
>     if not self._async_is_unique_name_port(user_input):
>   File "/usr/src/homeassistant/homeassistant/components/homekit/config_flow.py", line 251, in _async_is_unique_name_port
>     if entry.data[CONF_NAME] == name or entry.data[CONF_PORT] == port:
> KeyError: 'name'

I'm also confused because [Minimal Configuration](https://www.home-assistant.io/integrations/homekit/#minimal-configuration) doesn't mention Name and Port and [Configuration Variables](https://www.home-assistant.io/integrations/homekit#-configuration-variables) states they are optional.

I seem to have found the issue.
I must have previously "Ignored" a Discovered HomeKit Integration.
Unignoring this and restarting Core gave me the expected Notification and the Error is no longer present in the Logs.

Unsure if you wish to keep this ticket open to improve the helpfulness of the Error handling or maybe just add a note for dummys like myself in the Troubleshooting guide. But if neither, I'm happy for this issue to be closed.

Thanks for your time.
